label: Amendment to a contract (changing one clause)

review.note: Fixed wording is a plain single-clause amendment. It has not yet been reviewed by a practising advocate. The new wording is exactly what you confirm; none is added.

notes: An amendment usually needs to be signed by every party to the original agreement, and to be stamped as the state's stamp law requires.
If the original agreement says amendments must follow a particular procedure, follow it.

slots.label: What the clause says now (copy it exactly)
slots.example: The Client may terminate this Agreement at any time without notice.

slots.label: What it should say instead
slots.example: Either party may terminate this Agreement by giving 30 days' written notice to the other.

blocks.text: This Amendment is made at {{place}} on {{amendment_date|date}} between {{party_a_name}} and {{party_b_name}} (together the "Parties").
The Parties entered into the {{agreement_title}} dated {{agreement_date|date}} (the "Agreement"). The Parties now wish to amend {{clause_ref}} of the Agreement as set out below.
Amendment. {{clause_ref}} of the Agreement, which now reads: "{{old_wording}}" is replaced with: "{{new_wording}}"
Effective date. This Amendment takes effect on {{effective_date|date}}.
Other terms. All other terms of the Agreement remain unchanged and in full force.
Law. This Amendment is governed by the laws of India.
The Parties have signed this Amendment on the date first written above.
